provincial and municipal govermments and all cor-
porations owned or controlled by the Government,
are enjoined to require at least one-half of their
personnel to be on duty in the afternoon,
Hoads of government agencies and/or offices
involved in the implementation of the Administra-
tion's crash rice program and public works construc-
tion project shall make proper and necessary arrange-
ments and/or adjustments in their respective juris-
dictions of their office hours with a view to uti-
lizing available manpover services without detriment
to the deadlines and time schedules of the said pro-
gram and projects, provided that the five-hour office
schedule herein set shail not in any case be reduced.
Done in the City of Manila, this 29th day of
March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred
and sixty-seven.
(SGD.) FERDINAND E. MARCOS
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD. )RAFAEL M. SALAS
Executive Secretary
